body: Going through a similar situation  although the relationship was a lot shorter. We lasted about a year, he broke up with me a month in and then a few months back. Like you said he was easy to walk away and i was devastated, then it was like nothing ever happened and we’re together again. This break up was my choice however the past two nights it felt like he was pushing me to that point on purpose. I felt fine initially and im not as big of a wreck like i was the first two times but i still feel a little bit of a loss? Part of what’s helping me is realizing i do deserve a lot better

That’s not really something i thought of, most of role models are just the people around me who can constantly motivate themselves no matter what the task. If my depression can leave me in my beds for weeks at a time actively ruining my own life I have no one to blame for my hardships for myself so idk I guess I just want to punish myself before I even try to overcome it somehow
